# Read the encoded data from the binary and apply the decoding algorithm
# Algorithm: result[i] = data[i] ^ ecx ^ (i/2) ^ 0x5a
# where ecx starts at 0 and increments by 0x1f (31) each iteration

# Data from 0x403040 (42 bytes)
data = bytes([
    0x33, 0x21, 0x00, 0x6d, 0x5f, 0xab, 0x86, 0xb4, 
    0xd4, 0x2d, 0x36, 0x3a, 0x4e, 0x90, 0x8c, 0xe3,
    0xcc, 0x2e, 0x09, 0x6c, 0x49, 0xb8, 0x8f, 0xf7, 
    0xcc, 0x22, 0x4e, 0x4d, 0x5e, 0xb8, 0x80, 0xcb,
    0xd3, 0xda, 0x20, 0x29, 0x70, 0x02, 0xb7, 0xd1, 
    0xb7, 0xc4
])

result = []
ecx = 0
for i in range(42):
    d = data[i]
    # result[i] = data[i] ^ ecx ^ (i/2) ^ 0x5a
    # But ecx is actually the lower 8 bits used
    decoded = d ^ (ecx & 0xff) ^ (i // 2) ^ 0x5a
    result.append(decoded)
    ecx += 0x1f  # 31

decoded_string = bytes(result)
print("Decoded bytes:", decoded_string)
print("As string:", decoded_string.decode('latin-1'))
